quote:
Very disappointed.
Main character has the persona of a dish towel.
Which is quite in theme with the rest of the game.
There's too much focus on the relationship instead of genuine fun.
Gta is about anarchy,mayhem and criminality peppered with amazing characters.
Not to mention 30 fps.
The franchise was modified in a way that it doesn't even remind you of previous entries which the whole world loved.
Sad.
